name: How Much Does a Driveway Contractor Cost in Los Angeles County?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost per square foot for a driveway contractor in Los Angeles County?
mainEntity.text: What is the average cost per square foot for a driveway contractor in Los Angeles County?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no single countywide price because driveway projects vary widely by material and site conditions. A basic concrete driveway may cost less than a decorative paver system, but the final price can rise quickly if the existing driveway must be demolished, the base needs rebuilding, or the property has slope, poor drainage, or difficult access. In Los Angeles County, contractors also need to account for city permit requirements, hauling costs, and any work at the driveway apron or sidewalk interface. Homeowners should compare bids using the same scope: square footage, thickness, reinforcement, edge details, finish type, and whether cleanup and haul-away are included. The best estimate is one based on an in-person visit, because grading and drainage issues are often not visible in photos. A useful contractor quote should clearly separate material, labor, permit, and optional upgrade costs so the homeowner can see what is driving the total price.
acceptedAnswer.description: Driveway cost per square foot in Los Angeles County depends on material, thickness, demolition, base prep, drainage, and access. Concrete is usually priced differently from pavers, asphalt, or decorative finishes, and steep or narrow sites often cost more. The most accurate estimate comes from an on-site measurement that includes removal, haul-away, and any curb or apron work.
